data.name: DaGrogsVanillaWeaponRemix
data.teaser: "This rail can take this attachment irl wtf nikita"
data.description:
TYFONS WEAPON CUSTOMIZER IS REQUIRED FOR MAKING A GOOD AMOUNT OF ATTACHMENTS FIT WELL IN THIS MOD

====================================================================== This mod adds no new attachments, just moves some filter lists around to allow some guns and attachments to use reasonable attachments. I literally cannot explain all the changes but like 90% of vanilla guns are affected by this change, I made this for myself to not make all these changes by hand like I used to every time the game updated but I figured others may enjoy this.

This is a very jank mod so please expect some clipping hence why the above mod is recommended!!!

Examples of changes:

  • Glock 18c and pistols with actual muzzles, foregrips, slide sights
  • Shorty shotguns and rifles
  • Low customization guns now with some attachments
  • 9mm muzzles on ALL 9mm guns (like the sr3m or vsk with muzzle attachments)
  • too much to list seriously

This mod does affect my other mods, and mods that use the same vanilla attachments- so balancing of guns are affected since some mods just make guns better. I have not seen a conflict yet but as I said, without the above recommended mod then some customizations are unusable. It will be a lil groggi so you have been warned, install at your own risk. DO NOT USE WITH REALISM if its even out yet

TO INSTALL JUST UNZIP TO YOUR MAIN SPT DIRECTORY path is SPT > user > mods > (THREE FOLDERS) DaGrogsVanillaAttachmentPart1Remix, DaGrogsVanillaAttachmentPart2Remix, DaGrogsVanillaWeaponRemix

TO UNINSTALL JUST DELETE THE THREE FOLDERS IN mods AS I LAID OUT IN THE PATH ABOVE

versions.description:
**FIXED MP9 ADAPTER RECURSIVE LOOP**

- Uzi Pro Pistol had tactical slot expanded w/ lights and g36 rail
- Uzi Family all had stm-9 16 inch barrel added (i like making small guns long)
- MCX .300 Black Receiver Has 16 and 12 inch STM-9 barrel and 114 mm Uzi Barrel options added (ultra short builds ftw)
- MCX .300 Black Receiver Has AR-15 Carry handle and rfb upper rail sight added in scope slot
- SKS Tapco chassis has g36 bottom rail added and uzi a3 pro stock mount rail added
- .30 Cal rifles have 114 mm Uzi Barrel Option added (LETS MAKE RIFLES EVEN SHORTER LETS GOOOOO)

- PPsH got MP-155 stock for more tacticool looks (Thermal Camera works! Get creative if you want a sight on it that isnt blocked by the camera though. It is doable, just convoluted. Try stm barrel > mp9 mount > g36 bottom rail > UM3 mount > mount a sight > use weapon customizer to move all attachments to place.)
- Large UZI Got better sights and access to threaded pro barrels (Can now make it have a bipod, LMG SMG with the open bolt and 100 round mag!)
- UZI PROs got access to the normal UZI mags (yes that means the Dong-100) with access to threaded barrels and more sights for better customization!
- GLOCKS CAN RUN FISCHER NOW
- Small File Reformat for efficiency
Sorry about shotgun rib mounts... i put the right file in this time

- Fixed kedr adapter recurring loop
- Added scopes/rails to shotgun ribs!
- Looking into other possibilities that need some testing
- Small optimization here and there, and maybe a small change in customization I forgot about? Been sitting on this release for a bit so i forgor

- Kedr Threaded Adapter AND RFB thread nut now allows new 9mm muzzles onto vanilla 7.62, .338, .300blk, and 6.8 caliber weapons
- Added AKS-74u handguards to saiga 12 and RPK-16 (goliath handguard clips into gas tube a bit, but i find it fine.)
- Mosin has a bit less restrictions now
- M4 SAI QD handguards and Jailbreak muzzle device allows use of some more vanilla silencers and barrel lengths
- M700 has new mounts via RFB top rail or B13 mount to allow small optics or even iron sights (FINALLY)

- SVT/AVT customization expanded (via the barrel rear sight and front sight slot)
- RFB/M700 weaver rail allows sprut in scope and rear slot (Use weapon customizer mod to move it around, expands use of lights and grips with just a top rail!)
- RPK-16 now has access to standard AK parts like guards, stocks, dust covers
- g36 bottom rail bipod slot allows lights, can have a grip and light on same attachment now! (great when combined with sprut, try it on the SVT/AVT)

*MPR45 bug may have been related to APBS, it was updated recently so try updating your APBS to most recent version and check the config in for MPR45 database mutation setting, at least per user reports. I cannot say if this is true or not as I do not know just a possible solution.*

- Added minor adjustments including RFB rail integration on a few weapons/attachments to help add iron sights to otherwise not allowed platforms
- MPR45 bug may still be around since I could not track down what is causing it no matter the mod combination I tried, seriously no clue since it has not popped up on my end still
